text: BlinDate connects people through blind date matches using digital twin dating.
Clyde Rempillo is the founder of BlinDate.
BlinDate aims to foster genuine connections beyond the screen.
The project was launched on Kickstarter.
BlinDate's funding goal was $70,614.
The funding period for BlinDate was from March 22, 2025, to April 21, 2025.
BlinDate's funding was unsuccessful.
BlinDate was created out of a desire to revolutionize the modern dating landscape.
Clyde Rempillo started envisioning a radical approach to dating apps in 2021.
BlinDate aims to streamline the dating process.
BlinDate proposes the use of an intelligent system as a Personal Dating Assistant.
The Personal Dating Assistant will get to know users personally, including their tastes, passions, types, and values.
The assistant will find compatible matches based on important qualities users look for in a partner.
An intelligent system is proposed as a Personal Dating Assistant to streamline the dating process.
The Personal Dating Assistant will learn about users' tastes, passions, types, and values.
The assistant will find compatible partners and set up dates without user intervention.
In 2021, the idea of using artificial intelligence for dating was met with skepticism.
Many individuals in the dating market were hesitant to trust a machine with personal matters like love.
In 2022, the rise of ChatGPT made AI mainstream, influencing dating apps to adopt AI for matchmaking.
BlinDate aims to function as a true assistant that understands users and helps them navigate relationships.
Clyde has a background in AI/ML and Digital Twin technology.
Clyde was inspired to create a digital version of a person that could simulate multiple relationships.
The concept of Digital Twin was created to allow AI to learn from simulated relationships.
The Digital Twin concept is likened to Naruto’s Shadow Clone Jutsu, where clones learn on behalf of the original.
A similar concept to Digital Twin was explored in the Black Mirror episode 'Hang the DJ'.
The Digital Twin concept was created to simulate experiences and learning.
